reviewed_by: Codex source audit; release identity still requires review

catalogues.evidence: 2026-10-22 targeted live catalogues: legacy has one entry; xMart has eight rows including six translations, an MNCAH variant and a non-downloadable entry. Both clients selected F8E084CWHS4_100, not F8E08MNWHS4_100MNCAH or KO8G4W8WHS4_100.

definition.evidence: WHO GHO metadata registry 88 and data.who.int F8E084C describe DTP3 third-dose immunization coverage among surviving infants. https://www.who.int/data/gho/indicator-metadata-registry/imr-details/88 ; https://data.who.int/indicators/i/48D7D19/F8E084C

unit.evidence: Both official definitions express a percentage. Legacy NumericValue maps to xMart RATE_PER_100_N for the selected route; IND_UNIT is a descriptive title, not a coded unit.

population.evidence: Official definitions use surviving infants receiving three DTP-containing vaccine doses in the year. The selected route is the DTP3 age-one coverage indicator; no other age group is substituted.

estimate_type.evidence: Legacy catalogue explicitly identifies WUENIC. WHO data.who.int F8E084C lists WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage. This review covers that selected route only, not administrative coverage or the MNCAH variant.

geography.evidence: Independently downloaded rows identify PHL/COUNTRY in legacy and M49 608/COUNTRY in xMart. No regional aggregation or historical membership mapping was used.

time.evidence: Both extracts contain exactly annual YEAR rows for 2020 and 2021. The legacy interval endpoints and xMart DIM_TIME are retained in raw evidence.

dimensions.evidence: For these two rows only: all legacy Dim1-Dim3 and their types are null. All 24 native xMart breakdown fields are null. xMart publication state is PUBLISHED; legacy's catalogue lists PUBLISHSTATE but its returned observation fields do not expose that state. Native xMart numeric measures contain only RATE_PER_100_N. Breakdown structure is checked, but no identical publication-state assumption is made. reviewed_stratum is reserved for the specifically reviewed series; null is not generally mapped to total.

release.evidence: Legacy Date is 2025-07-14T16:23:12.92+02:00; xMart Sys_CommitDateUtc is 2026-05-18T18:07:03.23+08:00. The official indicator page displays a 15 July 2025 update. These are different timestamp concepts and do not establish matching dataset release IDs. Do not approve cross-backend parity from the matching sample values.

limitations: Review applies only to PHL, 2020-2021 and the selected native route.
No verified cross-backend parity claim while publication-state mapping and release identity remain unresolved.
